title: CommandList
description: Everything a bot advertises it will answer.

Command.description: One command: what people type after `/`, what it does, and what it takes.

description.description: What it does, in the bot's own language, 1 to 100 characters.

descriptions.description:
The description in other languages, by BCP 47 tag, which a client shows in place of
`description` when its language matches.

name.description:
What people type after `/`: 1 to 32 printable characters of any script, but no
whitespace or emoji. Unique among the bot's commands, ignoring case.

parameters.description: What it takes, in order; optional ones come last.

description.description: What to give it, 1 to 100 characters.

name.description: Its name, shown while it is typed; the same rules as a command's.

optional.description: Whether it may be left out; only the last parameters may be.

pattern.description: For a `regex` parameter, and only for one: what a value must match whole.

type.description: What it must be, which the server checks before the bot hears of it.

ParameterType.description: What a parameter's value must be.

oneOf.description: Someone's id; a client completes it from the people there.
A channel's id, one the person invoking may view.
A message's id, one the person invoking may read.
A community's id, one the person invoking belongs to.
A role's id, of the community the command is invoked in.
A file the person invoking attaches to the command.
A deployment's domain, as federation names deployments.
Any text; as the last parameter it takes the rest of what was typed.
Text that matches the parameter's `pattern` whole.
